_comment: Z2 dire wolf (intermission triage Session ②, item 18): the stronger Z2 wildlife variant. Own sprite/EntityType since the unique-art pass (PO 2026-07-21 — every mob reads distinctly, higher tier looks meaner); shares the WolfBite skill; the step-up is pure curveLevel (2 → 6, ~1.6× the pool/damage per Philosophy A) plus a bigger body. Carries Wild since the C8 drop-rate pass (PO 2026-07-20) — the feral aura's live home after its legacy SaberToothCat source stayed behind in proving-grounds; apex predator of the Session-④ wolf-heavy predator forest (overrides the item-18 dropless note). Chance kph-derived (Z2 ≈20 min expected, C8 FINAL). KeenEye rare added post-FINAL (PO choice 2026-07-20, backlog §23): the crit-stat passive as a Dire-style chase drop — the wolf line owns the precision identity (EliteWolf → Reaper). Chance 0.06 [PLACEHOLDER].
